text: Pip just landed the last shot and the whole raid is running away!
We cleared the gate room without a single scratch, chat, I'm shaking!
Mara hit level twelve in shooting and she's unstoppable now!
Look at that loot pile, it goes all the way to the wall!
Rook pulled the door shut a half second before the swarm hit it!
Three legendary drops in one expedition, are you kidding me!
Odessa just tamed the giant thing from the yellow hallway!
That trade caravan has exactly the part we've needed for two weeks!
Socks the cat caught the anomaly and dragged it home like a mouse!
Bram finally finished the reactor and the lights are all on!
Sorry, sorry. I'm talking fast because my hands won't stop shaking right now.
My heart is pounding and that was the best fight we've ever had.
Chat is going absolutely wild and honestly so am I.
Did everybody see Juno block that charge with her bare shield?
Can we please do that expedition again right now?
Are we really about to open the deepest gate tonight?
Is that a full stack of gold sitting in the corner?
How did Ivy survive that when she was down to one leg?
Who wants to name the new muffalo, quick, give me names?
What are the odds we found the secret room on our first try?
Everybody grab the shiny stuff and get back through the gate, go go go!
Hollis, sprint for the door, you can make it!
Okay, okay, breathe, we're actually winning this one.
Whew, my legs are jelly. I need to stand up for a second, that was too much.
Don't worry, Tamsin's patched up and we're totally fine now!
[laughter] We did it, we actually did it!
Scar threw the grenade and it bounced right into their camp! [laughter]
[laughter] I'm screaming, Pixel just called that exact room before we opened it.
[laughter] Did the company just send us a bonus check for that?
Moss, you predicted the raid timing to the hour and I love it!
Welcome in, Juniper, you showed up for the best moment of the whole stream!
Nova just subbed right as the boss went down, perfect timing!
Every single colonist made it home and I can't stop grinning.
That's the rarest room in the whole map and we're standing in it!
Wait, is the company actually promoting us to tier three?

We have a working teleporter now, chat, a real one! Bram just stepped on the pad and popped out across the map in a flash of blue light! He's laughing so hard he can barely stand up! Every expedition just got ten times faster!
Okay chat, it's happening! The gate is open and it's glowing gold!
Pip found a hidden vault behind the wallpaper! There's armor in there, real armor!
I'm not even pretending to be calm. That was the cleanest raid defense I've ever pulled off.
Did you see Mara's headshot? Can somebody clip that for me, please?
Where did all this silver come from? How is the vault this full?
Cobalt, clip that right now! I need that moment forever.
Somebody start a poll right now. Do we go deeper or bank the loot?
We survived the solar flare with power to spare! The batteries actually held!
Okay, okay, focus. I'm too excited to play properly right now.
Don't panic, chat, this is the good kind of alarm! It means the drill hit something huge!
Rook's finally out of the hospital bed! He's walking, he's fine, he's back!
Our expedition team just walked through the gate with full bags. I'm literally bouncing in my chair.
Ivy built the whole kitchen in one day! We have a real kitchen!
Is that a mechanoid core just lying there? Can we take it home?
Who's ready for the biggest contract we've ever taken? Because I signed it already!
Twenty subs in a row, Wren, that's incredible! Thank you so much!
Bram parried the blade and countered in the same move! I've never seen him do that!
I've been waiting three streams for this room to spawn. It's finally here and it's beautiful.
[laughter] Oh my gosh, it worked! The trap actually worked!
Hollis tripped and the enemy tripped over him! [laughter] And then we won!
[laughter] I can't believe that plan worked. I made it up in five seconds.
Static Fern called the twist and now everyone owes her a cookie! [laughter] Chat, pay up!
[laughter] Did we just beat the raid with a muffalo stampede? Is that even allowed?
Lantern, write that down! That's going in the stream highlights tonight!
It's okay, it's okay, everyone made it! We're so back!
I'm going to remember this fight for years. Wow.
Here they come, the whole caravan with every crate we ordered! Juno's already unpacking, the medicine is in there, and so are the rifles! This is the best day this colony has ever had!
So the gate collapsed behind us and we thought we were stuck forever. Then Pip found a second exit nobody had mapped. We came out right next to the base with every single bag full!
Chat, chat, chat, look at the screen! That's a whole new layer of the Backrooms under the pool rooms! Nobody on the forums has posted about this yet, we might be the first ever!

I've got goosebumps right now, honestly. Mara held that doorway alone for almost a full minute while the others dragged Scar to safety. Then the reinforcements showed up and the whole fight just flipped in our favor.

Okay, the contract says three artifacts and we came back with five! The company is going to lose their minds over this. I'm already planning what we buy with the bonus. New turrets, new beds, and honestly, maybe a heated pool for everybody!

[laughter] I need everyone to understand how ridiculous that was. Odessa missed every single shot for the whole fight. Then she landed the one that mattered and took down the leader. Now she's acting like she planned it the whole time!

Biscuit just raided us with forty people, welcome in, all of you! You picked the perfect time to show up! We're about to open the sealed door that's been taunting us for a week! Get comfy, this is going to be wild!

Research is done, chat! We can finally build the gate stabilizer! No more collapses, no more panic runs, no more losing people in the dark! I'm so happy right now, chat, that I could honestly cry a little bit!

Are you all seeing this right now? Every wall in this room is made of glowing tiles and they're humming. Pip says the hum matches the gate frequency perfectly. Does that mean what I think it means, chat, because I really hope it does?

What do we even do with this much steel? We could build a second base, chat. We could build a wall around the whole map. Honestly, why not both, if Bram promises to stop complaining about hauling all of it?
We were down to the last pack of medicine and Tamsin was bleeding out. Then a trader walked in out of nowhere with a full crate of it. I swear the game loves us tonight!

Wait wait wait, the drop pod has a person in it! She's a doctor, chat! A real doctor with level fifteen medicine! Chat, we're recruiting her, I don't care what it costs, she's staying with us forever and ever!
I had my whole speech ready about losing the base. Instead the turrets held, the walls held, and everyone walked away. I'm so proud of every single person in this little colony.
That rescue was perfect, Rook carried Ivy out with two seconds left on the collapse timer!
Next stream we're going all the way to level ten of the Backrooms, and I can't wait!
Honestly, chat, I've never seen a colonist go on a kill streak like Scar just did.
Everybody vote now, quick, because the gate only stays open for one more minute!
Hey Wren, welcome to everybody you brought, we just found an entire library down here!
Can you believe Socks the cat found the exit before any of us did?
Mara and Bram got married in the middle of a thunderstorm and it was perfect!
Anomaly contained, and we got a research boost out of it too!
My face hurts from smiling so much tonight, thank you all.
New record, chat, we've survived sixty days without a single loss!
You don't need to worry about the cold snap anymore, the heaters are all online!
How are we this lucky tonight, seriously, how?
[laughter] Juno named the new turret Biscuit after you, chat!
Look at the map, the whole east side just unlocked for expeditions!
Okay, I'm calling it, this is the best colony I've ever built!
Rook didn't make it out of the gate before it closed.
Yeah, chat. I keep looking at Pip's empty bed and it hurts.
Her letter just says she's sorry she couldn't come home.

We buried Hollis next to the garden he planted. Pip carved the headstone himself, even though his hands kept shaking. Mara put the first tomato of the season on top of it. Nobody said much, but everybody stayed until the sun went down.
Nobody say anything yet. I really thought we'd get Ivy to the hospital in time.
Socks keeps sleeping on Mara's grave and I can't take it.
Sorry, give me a sec. I'm going to need a minute before we keep going.
Gosh, this hurts. I was so sure she'd wake up after the surgery.
He was the first colonist I ever recruited, you know.
Is it weird that I miss Bram's terrible cooking already?
Can we just sit here quietly for a second, chat?
Do you think Tamsin knew we were coming for her?
Why did it have to be Juno, of all people?
How do I even tell the others about this?
What am I supposed to do with all of Odessa's paintings now?
It's okay, chat, thank you for the kind words, I mean it.
Thank you, Lantern, that really helps right now.
Somebody please carry Scar's helmet back to his room.
Leave the light on in the workshop, that was her favorite spot.
Mara's last words in the log were about the sunset.
Rook's dog keeps waiting by the gate for him.
We never got to finish the house we were building together.
Ivy left a note on the table that says back soon.
No, no, please don't go, not like this!
I can't believe we lost both of them in one night!
Listen to that, chat. Our colony feels so quiet without Pip humming in the kitchen.
Man, her handwriting. I keep rereading her letter and it doesn't get easier.
Juno gave her last medicine pack to a stranger and then she was gone.
Bram asked to be buried facing the gate, so that's what we'll do.
Should we name the new room after Hollis?
Tamsin was supposed to retire next week!
Hey, thanks for sticking around. I'm really quiet right now, I know, I'm sorry.
Hollis waved at the camera before he walked through the gate. That was the last time we saw him.
Odessa wrote a letter to her sister every single day. The last one never got sent.
I knew the odds were bad. I just didn't think they'd be this bad.
Scar was the one who taught everyone to shoot. Now the range just feels empty.
Remember when Pip set the kitchen on fire on day two? I keep thinking about that.
Why does the game always take the sweet ones? It's never the grumpy guy.
Hey, it's okay to be sad with me, chat. We loved her too.
Let's give Ivy a proper funeral. Everybody stop working for the ceremony.
Mara held on for three whole days in that hospital bed. I really thought she was going to make it.
I read the letter from Rook's mother out loud. She just wanted to know if he was happy here.
She was right there! I could see the exit and she was right there!
This is the part of the game I always forget about. It never stops hurting.
Socks found Juno's scarf in the hallway. He won't let anyone take it from him.
How do you say goodbye to someone who was there from day one? I honestly don't know.
We lost the whole east wing when the gate collapsed. Bram's workshop was in there, everything he made.
Is it okay if we just walk around the base for a bit? I'm not ready to play yet.
Thanks, Wren, I'm alright. Just sad, that's all.
Tamsin planted those roses for her daughter. Now they're blooming and she's not here to see them.
Hollis kept a list of everyone he wanted to thank someday. My name was on it.
I can't stop staring at the empty chair at the table. It was always hers.
I'm so sorry, Pip, I should have sent someone else!
Odessa's last painting was a picture of all of us around the fire. I'm hanging it in the dining room.
Rook and Ivy were supposed to get married next season. Now it's just Ivy, sitting by the window every night.
Put her name on the memorial wall. Right at the top, please.
Juno left the expedition early to save Scar, and she didn't come back. He found her pack by the gate this morning. It still had his favorite snack in it, the one she always saved for him.
I've been playing this colony for a really long time, and Mara was there for all of it. She survived the first winter, the first raid, the first gate. It doesn't feel real that she's gone.
So the letter came from the company today. It says Bram's contract has been fulfilled, like it was paperwork. They don't even know he was the one who kept everyone laughing on the bad nights.

I keep thinking about what I could have done differently. If I'd pulled her back one second earlier, maybe she'd be here. I know it's just a game, chat. It still really hurts, and I don't think that's going away tonight.
Pip's little brother found his toolbox this morning. He just sat on the floor holding it for an hour. Nobody told him to get back to work, and nobody will.
Hollis left a message on the radio before the gate closed. He said tell them I found the garden room, it's beautiful in here. Then the signal just went quiet.

We held a funeral for Tamsin tonight under the stars. Everyone came, even the prisoners. Socks sat on her coffin the whole time and wouldn't move. I didn't have the heart to make him leave, so we just let him stay there with her.

Can I tell you something, chat? I almost didn't log on today because I knew this was coming. Ivy's illness was getting worse every day and there was nothing left to try. I'm glad you're all here with me for it.

Odessa wasn't the best fighter or the best builder. She was just kind to everyone, every single day. Now the whole colony feels colder. I honestly didn't know one quiet person could matter that much to a whole colony.
Who's going to read stories to the kids now? Scar used to do all the voices. He was really bad at every single one of them, and honestly that was always the best part.

Rook's grave has flowers on it every morning. I didn't assign anyone to do that. Somebody in the colony just quietly does it on their own, every day, before anyone else wakes up. I really hope it's Socks, honestly.
This is the last picture we've of the whole original crew. Four of them are gone now.
Mara's goodbye letter is short, but every line of it hurts.
Bram left his favorite hat on the hook by the door. Nobody's touched it since.
Do you ever get attached to a pawn and then lose them like this?
We won the fight, but we lost Pip, and it doesn't feel like winning.
It's alright, Moss, you couldn't have known that raid was coming.
Ivy kept fighting for so long, and I'm proud of her, I really am.
It happened so fast. That gate swallowed Hollis whole and the room just went dark.
Note to self, I'm never getting this attached again, and I always will.
Where do we even start rebuilding after a night like this?
Even the muffalo seems sad today, it just stands by the empty pen.
Tamsin's apprentice is wearing her old coat now and it's way too big for him.
I really, really didn't want to lose her tonight!
Is Scar still breathing over there?
Did anyone see where Pip ran off to?
Is that blood trail leading toward the gate?
Should we really be sending Ivy in with that leg?
Why is Mara just standing in the hallway staring at the wall?
Where did the rest of the expedition team go?
How long has Bram been bleeding like that?
Somebody get Tamsin off the front line right now.
Rook, back away from the flickering door slowly.
Get the medicine kit to the hospital before it's too late.
Hang on, Juno, help is coming, just stay down.
Stay with me, Hollis, the doctor's almost there.
Something about that room feels really wrong to me.
That's the third mental break this week, I'm getting nervous.
Odessa's food poisoning is getting worse instead of better.
Listen, chat. I don't like how quiet the gate has been tonight.
Our power reserves just dropped below ten percent and it's still dark.
Pip hasn't eaten anything in two whole days.
Wait, the lights in the gate room just went red!
No, Ivy, don't go in there alone!
Is the wall actually cracking or am I seeing things?
Who left the gate unlocked overnight?
Scar's mood is sitting right at the edge of a breakdown.
Easy, Moss, we're not losing anyone today if I can help it.
Everyone pull back inside the walls, now.
He's been lying in the snow for a while now. Is Bram okay?
We've got two days of food left. Can we even make it home before the cold snap hits?
I haven't heard from Juno in an hour. Did the expedition radio just cut out?
It keeps getting louder. Should I be worried about that hum?
Odessa's fever is way too high. Is that infection spreading?
Because nobody went in there today. Are those footprints coming from inside the gate?
What's that thing in the corner of the yellow room? Why is it moving toward Pip?
I can only see the front line. How many raiders are out there, chat?
She was fine a second ago. Why isn't Mara getting up?
We had twelve packs this morning. Where's the medicine going so fast?
Rook, get to the hospital bed and stay there. You're not fighting with that wound.
Pull Ivy back from the edge of the room. Something's wrong with the floor.
Somebody check on Hollis, please. He's been in his room all day.
Keep the gate shut until we know what's on the other side. I mean it.
Hey, Tamsin, it's okay, breathe. We're going to get you out of there.
Don't worry, chat, I've got a plan for this. I think I've got a plan.
It's alright, Scar, the doctor's coming. Just hold the bandage tight.
You're doing great, Juno, keep crawling. The exit is right there.
I really don't like that sound. Something's under the floor.
That's not normal for this map. I've never seen the sky turn that color.
Okay, okay, think. If the gate collapses now, Pip's stuck in there.
Bram's been coughing for three days now. I'm starting to think it's not just a cold.
Mara's been staring at the gate every night this week. She's not sleeping either.
Our food stores are getting low and winter's coming. We need a plan, chat.
Odessa hasn't come back from the expedition yet. She was supposed to be back by noon.
That raid is way bigger than our defenses can handle. I'm honestly worried.
Pip's wound got infected overnight. We're running really low on antibiotics.
I can see something moving behind the wallpaper in that room. Nobody else seems to notice it.
Our turrets are almost out of ammo, and the second wave is coming. This could get really bad.
Juno's surrounded, chat! Somebody get over there now!
The fire is spreading toward the hospital! Get the patients out!
That's a whole pack of hounds heading for the farm! Move the animals!
There's a face in the static on the monitor. Wren, did you see that too?
What did the company mean by, report any unusual growths? Should I be checking everyone?
Hollis just got a letter from home. He's been really quiet ever since.
Is it just me, or are the halls getting longer every time we go in?
Nobody panic, alright, we still have one exit that's open.
Ivy's mood is tanking fast, chat. She needs a break before she snaps.
Biscuit, keep an eye on the timer for me, please. I can't watch it and the fight.
Tamsin went into the blue room alone and the door locked behind her.

Okay chat, I need you to help me watch the north wall, because something keeps showing up on the edge of the screen. It's there for a second and then it's gone. If anyone sees it again, tell me right away.

So Pip came back from the gate holding a key we've never seen before. He won't say where he found it, and he won't let anyone touch it. He's also stopped sleeping, and that scares me more than the key does.

Can we talk about Mara for a second? She's been skipping meals, skipping work, and just sitting by the window. I don't think it's the game being random. I think she really misses Rook, and How am I supposed to help her through this?

The gate's been making a grinding noise for about an hour now. Bram says it's fine, but his hands were shaking when he said it. I'm going to evacuate the workshop just in case. I'd rather be wrong and safe.

How are we supposed to hold the base with four people? Two of them are still injured from the last raid. Our walls are wood, our turrets are low, and the next wave is way bigger. Chat, does anybody have any ideas at all?

Juno's been gone for six hours on a two hour expedition. The radio only gives back static now. I keep telling myself she's fine, because she's always fine, she always comes home. I really hope that's still true tonight, chat.

Okay, listen, Ivy, you're going to be okay. The surgery is risky, but our doctor is good. We've done this before and it worked. Just hold on for one more night, please, because everybody here's waiting for you to wake up.

Everyone stop what you're doing and get inside right now. That fog isn't normal, it's coming from the gate. Close every door and don't open them for anyone. I'll explain everything once every single person is safe and accounted for, I promise.

Hollis has a fever, Odessa has the plague, and Scar just broke his arm. We have one doctor and she's exhausted. I'm genuinely worried we're going to lose somebody tonight. Let's be really, really careful with every decision tonight, chat.

That's the fourth time the floor plan changed. We mapped this hallway an hour ago, and now it goes somewhere else. I don't like it, chat. I really don't like it at all, and I want everyone out of here soon.
Are we sure the water's safe to drink after the anomaly?
Something's been eating our crops at night and we never see it.
Who's going to watch the gate tonight if Scar's still injured?
It's okay, Pixel, we saved the game before the expedition.

Every thirty seconds I'm checking on Pip, I can't help it. His fever spiked again, and our doctor is asleep on her feet. If it goes any higher, we're out of options. Please, please let this medicine kick in soon.
Why does Rook keep walking straight into the fire!
That's the third time the gate has collapsed on us today!
Bram, put the steel down and go to bed!
I've rebuilt this wall four times and the raiders keep picking it.
Mara just ate the fine meal I was saving for the party.
Every single shot missed, every one, from point blank range.
Of course the solar flare hits right when the turrets need power.
Unbelievable, truly. I literally just told him not to do that.
Why do I even make plans, honestly.
Are you serious, Pip, you're taking a nap right now?
Did the company seriously just send us more paperwork mid raid?
Can anyone in this colony haul a single thing without being told?
Who put the stockpile next to the explosives again?
Why is Hollis cleaning the floor while the base is on fire?
How did we lose the entire harvest to one bug?
Ivy, stop trying to tame the angry boar.
Somebody, anybody, just close the freezer door.
It's fine, it's fine, we'll just rebuild it again.
Okay, nobody panic, I'm only mildly annoyed.
Our doctor just went on a food binge in the middle of surgery.
Odessa, that's not a door, that's a wall!
We've failed this contract three times now and I'm losing my mind.
Was that really necessary, Tamsin?
One job, I gave him exactly one job.
Juno refuses to wear her armor because it's the wrong color.
No, no, no, not the generator! [laughter] Why is it always the generator!
Scar tripped over the cat, dropped the grenade, and blew up the kitchen! [laughter] Again!
[laughter] I'm laughing because otherwise I'll cry. That's the fifth fire this week.
[laughter] Are you kidding me? He went back for the hat?
Every single time I turn my back, something burns down. [laughter] Every time.
It's the size of a house! [laughter] How do you miss a muffalo?
We had one job, chat, one! [laughter] And we failed it spectacularly!
[laughter] So the trader we were saving silver for just got eaten by the hallway. I don't even know what to say.
Rook dropped the artifact in the gate! [laughter] He just let go of it!
[laughter] Somebody take the matches away from Pip. Forever, please.
I set up the perfect ambush and they came from the other side. Of course they did.
I spent two hours designing the killbox. They just dug through the back wall.
Pip refused to go through the gate because he didn't like the vibe. Then he walked in alone at three in the morning.
Bram started a mental break at the worst possible moment. He's wandering around the battlefield in his pajamas.
We lost the entire food stockpile to rot because nobody turned the cooler back on. I left a note and everything.
Our only doctor is the one who's injured. So now nobody can treat anyone.
Stop shooting the turret, Ivy! It's on our side!
Mara, the exit is right there! Why are you going back into the dark room!
The company changed the contract terms again! That's the third time today!
I literally built three new batteries. Did the power just go out again?
Because he's blocking everyone. Is Hollis really going to stand in the doorway the whole raid?
Just one, with no fires and no raids. Can we have one quiet day, please?
Did Juno just sell our best rifle to the trader? For a hat?
It's always that hallway. Why does every expedition go wrong in the exact same hallway?
She's eating it like candy. What is Odessa doing with the medicine?
He keeps taking it off. How many times do I have to tell Scar to wear the helmet?
Oh wait, that was me. Who decided to build the prison next to the armory?
Tamsin, get off the roof. You can't fix the turret from up there.
Everybody stop eating raw food, please. We have a kitchen for a reason.
Rook, go to bed. You've been awake for two days and you keep fainting.
This is fine. I'm totally calm, and this is totally fine.
I'm going to be so patient right now. So patient.
Okay, deep breath. Rebuild the wall, rebuild the wall.
It's okay, chat, we've survived way worse than this. Probably.
Don't worry, Cobalt, I'm not rage quitting. Not yet, anyway.
The gate keeps opening into the same dead end room. That's eight tries in a row now.
I paid the company for a map of level three. The map is just a blank page with a smiley face on it.
The hounds came back for round two! We haven't even finished fixing the door from round one!
Juno broke the only working cooler while trying to clean it. Now everything in the freezer is thawing.
We just finished the last one ten minutes ago. Seriously, another raid?
Why is every single colonist on fire right now!

So I finally convinced Pip to go through the gate, and he refused to come back out. He's just sitting on the floor in there, staring at the wallpaper. I've drafted him three times, and he keeps wandering off to the same corner.

We spent four days building the research bench, chat, four whole days. Then a meteor hit it, right in the middle. Not the field, not the empty yard, the bench. I'm starting to think this map hates me personally.

Why does the trader always show up the day after we sell everything? I swear they wait in the bushes for us to run out of silver. Then they come strolling in with all the stuff we needed. Does this happen to everyone, or just us?

Okay, the plan was simple, chat! Grab the artifact, walk back through the gate, close the door behind us! Instead, Rook stopped to admire a lamp, Ivy fell asleep, and Scar picked a fight with a vending machine!
I told everyone to stay away from the red room. I put up a sign, I put up a wall, and I put up a second wall. Bram dug through both of them to get inside. I don't know what else I can do here.

Alright, listen to me, all of you. Nobody touches the gate controls, nobody opens the vault, and nobody feeds the strange thing in the basement. I'm going to make a sandwich, and when I get back, I want everything exactly how I left it.

The cold snap killed the crops, the solar flare killed the heaters, and the raid killed the walls. I have one working thing left, chat. It's a bed. Somebody is going to set it on fire, I just know it.

Do you know how many times I've rebuilt this freezer? Seven times, chat, seven whole times. Every time a different colonist leaves the door wide open, and every time it's a brand new excuse. Today Hollis said he was letting the cold air out?

[laughter] I'm sorry, I just need to explain this chain of events. Pip tripped, Pip dropped the torch, the torch lit the rug, and the rug lit the gate. The gate then teleported the fire into the company headquarters, and now they're sending us a bill.

We finally get the gate stable and the company decides to schedule an inspection! Right now, in the middle of a raid! Their inspector just walked into the killbox! I can't believe I actually have to go rescue the company auditor now!

Mara and Juno are arguing about a chair, and the base is literally falling apart. The east wall is down, the turrets are empty, and the gate is flickering. Neither of them cares, because apparently the chair matters more. I'm going to sell that chair to the next trader.
How does Bram keep losing the same wrench in a room with no doors?
Ugh, chat. I had the perfect save, and I forgot to save it.
Another wall breach, and I just finished fixing that wall!
Wait, the gate just opened by itself!
Hold on, that wall wasn't there five seconds ago!
Whoa, Pip just one shot the boss with a pistol!
Did that vending machine just talk to Mara?
Was that a second sun in the sky just now?
Where did this entire flooded mall come from?
Who invited a whole circus to our base at midnight?
No way, the dead raider just stood back up and left.
Nobody told me the hallway could fold in half like that.
Huh, so the carpet is warm, that's new and terrifying.
There's a whole ocean behind the bathroom door!
Hang on, is Rook's long lost brother leading the raid?
Hollis just walked out of a wall that's solid concrete.
A muffalo with wings, chat, an actual flying muffalo!
How is Socks the cat on the roof of the gate?
Nope, nope, the lights all went off at once!
Don't panic, that's just the company drone, I think.

Wait, what? Those raiders just surrendered without firing a single shot, chat! They're walking up to the gate and handing us every single weapon they've got! Their leader is bowing to Scar like he's some kind of legend now!
Hold on, Juno's alive! She just walked out of the gate after three days!
Look at that, the floor opened up! There's a staircase going down forever!
Chat, the letter is from Tamsin! She wrote it before the gate took her!
Whoa, that trader is selling a ticket to the company headquarters! For twelve silver!
There are two of them now, chat. Hey, did the gate just spit out a second Bram?
The room is upside down and nobody's falling. Pixel, you're seeing this too, right?
Seriously, a thrumbo just walked into the freezer? Like, on purpose?
Nova, did you just gift fifty subs? Fifty?
Ivy can play the piano? Since when can Ivy play the piano?
Wait, that's the same room we left an hour ago? But everything's covered in snow now?
Hmm, what's that glowing thing in the pool? Why is it shaped like our base?
